Per the 2026-06-26 ruling, m_mu/m_e AND Q_beta are BOTH CAL-2 proxies (Q_beta = hbar/D_beta), and CAL-3 is D_pi with proxy m_pi -- which this very block's own closing paragraph states correctly. The two triples in one block disagree. (2) 7a -- 'pinned numerically by the lepton ratio m_mu/m_e through the Skein relation m_mu/m_e = Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2': that identity is not the skein relation, which is L_+ - L_- = (q - q^{-1}) L_0.
